split.replacement_policy: No replacement after role reservation; integrity failure makes evidence incomplete

input.slot_identity: Unique nonempty PersonId strings; canonical slots sorted (team 0 home then 1 away, PersonId encoded UTF-8 lexical bytes). Persist slot_ids and digest; raw roster/XML permutations canonicalize identically before RNG. Noncanonical direct batches reject.
input.timestamps: Retain all observed source timestamps exactly as UTC int64 nanoseconds in sparse source_time_frame_index/source_time_slot/source_time_utc_ns arrays, sorted (frame index, slot). Per-period origin chooses minimum observed source N, ball first then canonical slot. Every observed T within 1000000ns of origin+(N-originN)*40000000ns; missing/invalid timestamps and duplicate object/N fail.
input.masks: Derived player_observed=isfinite(positions).all(axis=2), ball_observed=isfinite(ball_xy).all(axis=1); no persisted masks. Raw incomplete/nonfinite coordinate pair becomes canonical float32 NaN pair (0x7fc00000), counted; typed batches reject partial pairs/inf.
input.target_lexical: Exact XML attribute strings only: status 0 -> D; status 1 with owner 1/2 -> H/A. Missing or any other string -> unknown, count aggregate. No whitespace stripping/coercion. Structural nonstring values, malformed IDs or timing fail. Outside positive periods unknown.

randomness.root_binding: protocol_sha256 is SHA256 of the fixed protocol.json bytes, which contain no raw/catalog/target byte digests. Study manifest separately binds this protocol digest AND catalog/source digests. Authorized synthetic target variants use the same protocol RNG root and fixture/role namespace, distinct source-integrity manifests; target mutation without separate authorization fails integrity. Never reseed from study/source/target/cache digest.
randomness.generator: Generator(PCG64(seed)); independent generator per listed stream, NumPy2.4.4. Scalar threshold uses < probability. No conditional draws. No chunk reseeding.

conditions.anchor: original coordinate at block_start-1; missing or first block gives NaN; no searchback or cross-period borrowing

corruption_semantics.blocks: Each contiguous positive run [a,b) in timeline order; B=ceil((b-a)/block_frames), block starts a+j*block_frames, last truncated. For each run call the same stream generator once: scalar masks random((B,),dtype=float64), player_dropout/stale_players random((B,S),dtype=float64). Traverse C order block then canonical slot; draws independent of observations/targets. Inactive rows have no block and receive no mask.
corruption_semantics.coordinates: Complete finite pairs only; canonical float32 NaN pair for missing. Input remains immutable; outside positive runs unchanged.
corruption_semantics.jitter: Exactly rng.standard_normal((N,S+1,2),dtype=float64), full C order frame then canonical player slots then ball then x/y; all timeline rows/slots drawn even inactive/missing. Multiply by 0.25 in float64. Start float64 copy of input, add only finite pairs in positive runs.
corruption_semantics.player_dropout: combined: threshold random((B,S),dtype=float64)<0.3 at 25-frame blocks; set selected player pairs NaN.
corruption_semantics.ball_gap: ball4/combined:100-frame blocks; ball12:300-frame blocks. threshold random((B,),dtype=float64)<0.4, set selected ball pairs NaN.
corruption_semantics.teleport: Exactly rng.random((N,2),dtype=float64), C order, all rows incl inactive/missing; column0<0.004 decides, angle=column1*(2*pi) float64. After previous corruptions, only retained finite ball in positive run receives float64 20*cos(angle),20*sin(angle).
corruption_semantics.stale_players: 50-frame blocks; random((B,S),dtype=float64)<0.15. Anchor ORIGINAL pair at block_start-1; first run block or missing anchor produces NaN whole selected block; never borrow another block/period or search back. Ball unchanged.
corruption_semantics.view_gap: 50-frame blocks; random((B,),dtype=float64)<0.2; selected blocks set all players and ball NaN.
corruption_semantics.arithmetic: combined uses one float64 working copy: jitter, player dropout, ball gap, teleport in that order; cast once to float32 after all operations and canonicalize NaNs. Other conditions copy float32 exactly except assigned canonical NaNs/original float32 anchors. Do not clip coordinates.
corruption_semantics.chunk_equivalence: Normative logical Generator calls above define exact arrays. Implementer may materialize them, or prove bitwise equivalent generation independent of chunk boundaries; simply changing standard_normal call partitioning is not presumed equivalent. No conditional draws/reseeding or per-chunk casts.
corruption_semantics.symmetry: Canonical raw identity permutations produce identical conditions. Anonymous clean feature summaries are within-team permutation invariant. Arbitrary already-indexed noncanonical arrays are rejected, not promised pathwise RNG invariance; any internal co-permutation must transport slot_ids and masks together.
corruption_semantics.row_sampling: For L>cap=30000 choose eligible_ids[j*(L-1)//(cap-1)] for j=0..cap-1 using integer arithmetic; L<=cap retains all. No random draw and no floating linspace.
corruption_semantics.boundary_none_sampling: Per match/condition independent boundary_none_sampling stream: rng.choice(N_none,size=min(N_none,20*max(1,N_positive)),replace=False,shuffle=True) over ascending eligible NONE frame IDs; map and sort selected IDs before combining positives.
corruption_semantics.targets_and_timeline: Unchanged, never read by corruption or its RNG.

fit.emitter_rows: stride5 from each contiguous positive run start; retain known target; concatenate ascending eligible IDs; if L>cap=30000 select eligible_ids[j*(L-1)//(cap-1)] for j=0..cap-1 with integer arithmetic; same IDs every condition
fit.emitter_weights: each eligible original class k in match m and condition c has weight1/(2*4*3*n_mck); split weight equally between original and H/A-swapped copy; missing stratum/class fails; finally divide ALL actual fit-row weights by their global mean so sum(weights)=actual augmented fit-row count
fit.boundary_targets: edge t-1 to t; NONE unchanged, TEAM_CHANGE H/A, LIVE_DEAD one D; both known same positive run and geometry valid; exact edge no dilation
fit.boundary_none_sample: uniform no-replacement min(N_none,20*max(1,N_positive)) per match/condition; all positive edges; empty stratum or globally absent head class fails
fit.boundary_weights: inverse inclusion probability times sqrt(N_eligible/(3*N_class)) using full known eligible fit population; normalize final per-match-condition sum to1/8; finally divide ALL actual fit-row weights by their global mean so sum(weights)=actual retained fit-row count
weight_normalization_order: row selection and inverse inclusion for boundary
within-match-condition class balance for emitter or global sqrt-inverse-prior for head
global mean1 using actual rows seen by HGB
fit.runtime_environment_binding: CPython3.13.12, numpy2.4.4, sklearn1.9.1, scipy1.18.1 as existing locks; inspect installed exact versions and complete lock hashes at registration; mismatch blocks, no automatic upgrade

source_closure.scientific_legacy_modules: Every transitive imported accepted possession_model/noise_v2/validation/public metric source, training locks and actual environment inventory; content hashes captured at registration
source_closure.rule: Register CLI dispatch for all commands before training; release-only modules may be implemented later, but cannot mutate or replace any scientific dependency. Final release manifest adds exact full runtime closure.

provenance_stages.prefit: Immutable study binds scientific source/protocol/configuration/features/mappings/policy/environment, complete source catalog and accepted comparator model bytes. New C0/C1/head bytes do not exist and have no placeholder hashes at registration.
provenance_stages.postfit: After exactly three successful fits, seal models/models.json and C0/C1/head bytes immutably, referencing original study digest, source/input identities and numeric parity receipts. Seal all three before selection reservation/access; never amend original study.
provenance_stages.pretest: Finalist seal binds selected config/model/head, full postfit models seal, comparator and selection result before test reservation; rehash all applicable identities.
provenance_stages.G08: Rehash prefit study/source/config/policy/comparator, postfit model seal, finalist and exact runtime/release closure; no stage substitutes later bytes into earlier evidence.

decoder.base_cost: 12.5=accepted0.5transition_seconds*25; registration verifies exact scalar and comparator config/model/source hashes
decoder.boundary_head: one identical C1-curriculum head for every alpha>0 candidate
decoder.alpha_zero: exact accepted output/ties for numerically valid inputs; new decoder rejects both signs of finite-arithmetic overflow even unused alternatives, accepted source unchanged
decoder.symmetry: objective and optimal-set equivariance always; output equivariance only unique optimum; canonical ties separate
decoder.invalid_support: observation-invalid windows produce q=0; malformed caller q NaN/inf/range/shape rejects, never coerces
decoder.flattened_control: F080 uses same accepted emitter/shared head/alpha0.8 as B080. For each contiguous positive run and support type, eligible t>runstart with valid[t,type]. np.mean(q[eligible_ascending,type],dtype=np.float64) with pinned NumPy, cast once np.float32, assign only those edges; invalid/start/outside0; empty0. Validate all q first; no labels; nonmutating. F080 is normally selection eligible.
decoder.head_validation: Read byte limit524288 before JSON parse; duplicate keys reject; at most96 trees,1..13nodes/tree, acyclic rooted graph, every node reachable, exactly one parent except root, exact class/feature order, finite legal numeric fields. boundary_support calls raw_scores externally in batches<=4096 and writes directly to float32[N,2]. Tree count3..96 divisible3, complete class iteration groups0,1,2; root0; internal children distinct; leaf left/right integer0 sentinels ignored as graph edges.

evaluation.primary: Official pooled H/A spell_scores(...,ious=[.3,.4,.5,.6,.7])[mean_f1], exposed as spell_f1_mean; pool H/A spell TP/FP/FN at each IoU then mean thresholds, never macro-average team F1 or run F1. Equal condition then match means.
evaluation.unknowns: official valid_runs separately per contiguous positive period; retain global indices; predictedX forward-fill then leading backfill within each run; allX staysX; no additional censoring or timeline compression
evaluation.selection_gate: same margins on singleWPY; never call significance; select eligible max, no eligible =>no fresh test
evaluation.uncertainty: Fixed report: both whole-match paired deltas, their observed minimum/maximum, arithmetic mean, N=2 and provider/shared-club dependence limitations. No confidence interval, p-value, significance, population generalization or hidden-performance claim; no frame bootstrap.
evaluation.attribution: selection only: B080-A; F080-A; B080-F080 temporal-placement control; C0-A; C1-C0 curriculum replacement not stale-only effect; D0-C0,D1-C1. No test ablations.
evaluation.transition_aggregation: Diagnostic external wrapper calls official transitions and match_transitions separately for each positive-period/known-GT run, retaining global offsets, typed=to and inclusive12/25frames. Sum matched/missed/spurious counts as TP/FN/FP before precision/recall/F1; no cross-run matching or average run F1. This intentionally isolates matching unlike calling public evaluate on all runs; official spell metric unchanged.
evaluation.frame_aggregation: Official confusion/scored_confusion3x4/per_class_prf, absent or unpredicted class F1=0; macro_f1 unweighted H/A/D, never drop absent classes. Frame predictionsX are misses on known GT only.

access.prior_snapshot: immutable historical ledger prefix hash/length and roles; study identity binds snapshot
access.live_ledger: local/v3-control/consumption.jsonl; global cross-study OS-locked atomically checked and fsynced
access.selection_reservation: entire WPY role once before any label-bearing parse; all declared candidates within same live attempt
access.test_reservation: both WN1/WQQ atomically reserved before earliest label-bearing parser/cache access
access.retry: none after reservation for selection/test; interrupted reservation consumes cohort; no stale-lock reset; root may finish recorded result from already sealed complete artifacts only, no reevaluation
access.cache_hits: Study-domain cache hits/misses require live AccessCapability; release-domain observation/feature caches require verified ReleaseAccess with no study/ledger lookup. Both require complete hashes/schema and retained CacheLease handles; release authority never authorizes targets or study caches.
access.transport_integrity: Opaque download and cryptographic hash/size verification may precede reservation; no parser/decompression-to-records/field inspection before capability
access.cache_lifetime: Acquire and retain Windows handles denying WRITE and DELETE for manifest and all members before verification through consumption; map same held identities, never close/reopen by path. Failed locks/identity changes fail closed.
access.release_authority: InferenceContext holds ReleaseAccess bound to verified release/source/runtime/model hashes, observation-only input schema, process identity, cache root and public policy. Exact tactical ATD XML/TXT allowlist (or isolated synthetic fixtures); targets, IDSSE label-bearing XML, study cache domain and original control state prohibited. No study directory/ledger dependency.

resource.disk_definition: all new campaign raw originals,caches,models,reports,packages,envs count; preexisting originals do not; preserve all original downloads; forecasts before acquisition, abort growth before cap
resource.benchmark_cache: unique empty cache per uncached run; cached separately diagnostic; exact same raw input
resource.tree_measurement: OS worker highwater plus concurrent descendant working-set sampler interval<=50ms; memory job/cap monitoring before spawn
resource.measurement_limits: Report worker OS highwater separately from sampled concurrent process-tree peak and monitor gaps; sampled tree peak is a lower bound, not proof of instantaneous hard cap. Enforce OS job limits where available; fail admission if supervisor cannot enforce bound. Uncached means fresh process/empty application cache, not cold OS file cache. Synthetic resource preflight before fresh cohort reservation.

schedule.late_policy: stop new fit/test stage if latest start missed; preserve completed evidence; do not bypass gates; fallback remains selected
schedule.feasibility: These are stop policies, not measured feasibility or evidence of completion; actual preflight/resources required.

release.minimal_environment: CPython3.13 with requirements-lock.txt only; no sklearn/scipy at inference
release.review: isolated versioned review state/server using accepted static assets unchanged; synthetic browser acceptance only
release.promotion: exact tested ZIP/manifest/report hashes plus root receipt; explicit v3 launcher; accepted default remains available
release.core_equivalence: Post-science wrappers may not alter features, decoder, parameters, label/frame mappings, models or scoring. Final E2E rehashes exact scientific core/config/model bytes and verifies runner/CLI/UI output equality with direct frozen infer; no unchecked postprocessing.
release.scientific_api: experiments.v3.core.predict_codes(features,models,config,policy); frozen before fits, used by selection/test and release runner. InferencePolicy external has no forced intervals; public challenge uses protocol public bounds and forced D scores before decode. No labels/tags or wrapper postprocessing.

publication.paths: --out and --report must be distinct regular filenames in the SAME absent new generation directory under an existing non-aliased trusted output root; commit.json reserved. Reject different parents, any existing generation parent/destination, aliases/symlinks/reparse paths/collisions before input access.
publication.commit: Create unique sibling temporary directory; write and validate CSV, write report binding CSV hash, write commit.json binding both hashes/bytes plus release/source/policy identities. Flush/fsync each file, close writer handles, verify complete pair, atomically rename whole directory to absent final generation. Never replace a previous generation.
publication.crash: Before rename final directory absent and scratch may remain; after rename complete committed pair visible. No individual-file publication. Restart ignores/quarantines scratch and incomplete directories; never completes/overwrites previous output. New run uses new generation directory.
publication.readers: UI/download/export only expose a generation after strict commit-manifest/member hash/schema verification under held read handles. UI retains old complete generation on failed run; switch in-memory generation under state lock only after validation, derive csv/report from same generation. Restart scans complete generations only; no mutable per-file pointer.

forced_dead_authority.meaning: Explicit public [110808,113742),2934 dead frames; interval unchanged. URL is a mutable main locator; exact bytes bound by digest.
